purpose: Remove remaining implementation degrees of freedom before any eligible prospective Primitiva result is evaluated.

prospectiveCalendar.verifiedAgainst: SELAE official La Primitiva help/schedule pages on 2026-08-18

transferExecution.historyRule: Use only Primitiva draws with drawDate strictly before targetDrawDate.

graph.edgeWeight: count prior-window co-occurrences of each unordered number pair
graph.clustering: unweighted local clustering among positive-weight neighbours
graph.neighborEntropy: Shannon entropy of normalized incident edge weights divided by log(max(2, neighbourCount))
graph.normalization: For each feature over numbers 1..49: z-score, then unit(x)=0.5+0.5*tanh(x/2).
graph.ticket: top 6 numbers by score, sorted ascending for persistence
graph.frozenConfigSource: the 12 v138 leaders in their persisted order

matchedCostRandom.slotMapping: slotIndex 0..11 maps permanently to source leader order 0..11
matchedCostRandom.finalPValue: For each configuration, compare its cumulative mean hits over the fixed 200 target draws with the 10000 matched random replicate cumulative means for the same slot. One-sided Monte Carlo p=(1+count(nullMean>=observedMean))/(10000+1).

marginalFrequency.ranking: descending count in the strictly-prior target history window; tie ascending number

recency.recentTicket: 6 numbers with smallest draws-since-last-seen; tie ascending number
recency.overdueTicket: 6 numbers with largest draws-since-last-seen; tie ascending number

fixedDecisionBoundary.reason: The parent preregistration required at least 200; fixing the primary boundary to exactly 200 before the first eligible target result blocks optional stopping.
fixedDecisionBoundary.extremeEventAuditException: A sealed 5/6 or 6/6 may be disclosed only to trigger the preregistered lineage/null audit; it cannot alter configs, baselines, boundary or multiplicity.
fixedDecisionBoundary.laterRowsPolicy: Any later evidence belongs to a separately preregistered replication/version.

finalInference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the 12 frozen configurations using matched-cost Monte Carlo p-values.
candidatePassRequiresAll: observed mean hits greater than matched-cost random mean
observed mean hits greater than corresponding frozen marginal-frequency baseline
observed mean hits greater than frozen recent recency baseline
observed mean hits greater than frozen overdue recency baseline
finalInference.promotion: A passing configuration is a transfer signal only. It does not authorize real-money play; an untouched preregistered replication is still mandatory.
